value.rationale: The integral homotopy type of an actual group quotient is not implied by the previously known covering sphere type, fixed spaces, or rational orientation character. The explicit S_k-representation sphere classification resolves all subgroup fixed-space dimensions and naturally generates real projective suspension quotients of odd paths, including new two-torsion in the quotient of a torsion-free S^5 independence complex.
